raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Delivery batch 12 (ingested 2026-01-17) sent txn_ts as 'DD/MM/YYYY HH:MM:SS' instead of ISO, which breaks the TIMESTAMP cast. The day is 16 or later, so it cannot be read as a month, and the times of day (~06:00) match the other batches, so no timezone shift is implied. Parsing both formats deterministically recovers the correct timestamps.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.86, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, ts AS txn_ts, CAST(ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, CASE WHEN regexp_matches(txn_ts, '^\\d{2}/\\d{2}/\\d{4} \\d{2}:\\d{2}:\\d{2}$') THEN strptime(txn_ts, '%d/%m/%Y %H:%M:%S') ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') s;"}}
